status: CLI combines offline service-manager status with the authenticated Doctor view; online health is also in System.
setup: CLI host operation enables user startup and opens the local Console; no account required.
service install: Host operation: manage only this installation's service; cannot depend on a running web server.
service start: Host operation: manage only this installation's service; cannot depend on a running web server.
service stop: Host operation: manage only this installation's service; cannot depend on a running web server.
service restart: Host operation: manage only this installation's service; cannot depend on a running web server.
service status: Host operation: manage only this installation's service; cannot depend on a running web server.
service uninstall: Host operation: manage only this installation's service; cannot depend on a running web server.
secret set: Host-only private credential write from stdin; browser and models never read stored secret values.
secret list: Host-only credential names; Console Doctor reports reference presence without values.
watch create: First-watch Console flow uses the same compiled preview and reviewed apply.
notify test: First-watch Console flow requests native notification permission and a labeled test.
update check: Host updater verifies signed release metadata independently of the daemon.
update install: Host updater preserves a backup, enforces installation ownership and waits for service readiness.
update recover: Host updater reconciles its persistent journal even when the daemon cannot start.
cloud login: Explicit host connection: browser approval, private device credential, and revocation; never enrolls during local setup.

cloud logout: Explicit host connection: browser approval, private device credential, and revocation; never enrolls during local setup.
